purpose: fixed-upstream shared-harness diagnostic; not full BR1-PERF qualification
order: rotate cases by pair; alternate upstream/current order and time/rate order
clocks: whole fixed-work or completed-rate window wall and calling-thread CPU; no phase profiler

bootstrap.interval: exploratory paired-process median 95%; no NI Pass

qualification_limits: No pre-approved M non-inferiority margin: do not infer equivalence from a CI crossing 1
H=0, single thread and fixed in-flight=1; no per-event tails, pressure or product replay
No full metadata/allocation/background-drain counters; manager destruction is not complete retirement
Alias includes native operation management/content decisions but excludes prebuilt source initialization; label lifecycle operation, not pure M
K is a common memcpy control with ready read pins, not a production brush/SIMD kernel qualification
Rate is independently measured completed work; fixed-loop aggregate is not a single-event latency distribution
